ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for Chicago MCS students only. This course will be taught on the Coursera platform. This section may have one or more proctored online exams. Students in on-campus programs will have no additional proctoring fees. Students taking a credit-bearing Illinois course on the Coursera platform for the first-time must complete a short onboarding course to gain course access. Additional information is available at https://ws.engr.illinois.edu/sitemanager/getfile.asp?id=3552. In-person exams scheduled in 200 S. Wacker Dr. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/CSregister
